Students, Housewives, Accountants, Doctors, Lawyers, Individuals working in Banking and Financial institutions, Administrative and managerial, teachers, Bankers, person engaged in Administrative, Secretarial and Managerial occupations. Shopkeepers, Salesmen, Commercial Travellers and persons employed in occupations of similar nature.
Builders, Contractors and Engineers engaged in superintending functions only.

Paid drivers of Motor cars and Light Motor Vehicles and persons engaged in occupations of similar nature. Persons engaged in handling goods, chemicals, Grains elevator, farmers, shooting gallery, Motor Driving Instructor, Public transport, Construction works, Geologist, Surveyor for Oil companies, Heavy equipment Operators, Security Guards, Forestry, Civil Surveyors, Firemen, Photo Graphers, Offshore works, Persons engaged in Sports Duty, Film Show and shooting except as Stuntmen.

Persons working in underground mines, explosives, magazines, workers involved in electrical installation with high tension supply. Circus personnel, persons engaged in activities like racing, horse back riding, big game hunting, Mountaineering, winter sports, skiing, ice hockey, ballooning, hand gliding, river rafting, polo, Stuntmen in film and persons engaged in occupations / activities of similar hazard.
